candidates.source_context: This package governs the prepared boundary. Package `N-05` separately governs which common-envelope facts are referenced or carried into the common stage context and which facts belong only in stage-specific carriers. `N-05` may not weaken the prepared-envelope requirements defined here.

There is no repository-wide precedence order such as market before options before provenance, provider A before provider B, latest before earlier, non-empty before empty, file order, insertion order or dictionary update order. Canonicalisation must resolve each semantic field under an explicit field-resolution rule owned by the applicable source or preparation contract.

A field-resolution rule must name the semantic field, admitted candidate sources, source-family roles, required type/unit/temporal alignment, equality tolerance where applicable, conflict class, authorised selection or substitution rule, required lineage, and failure/degradation outcome. A generic merge helper may execute those rules but may not invent them.
A canonical value may be selected from unequal candidates only when the field-resolution rule expressly authorises one of the following for that semantic field:

Freshness, confidence or non-null status is not inherently authoritative. It may decide a field only when the field-resolution rule names it and defines how incomparable precision, stale intervals, source quality and contradictory values are handled.

If unequal candidates exist for a mandatory single-valued semantic field and no field-resolution rule lawfully resolves them, canonicalisation must fail closed for that field and withhold an authoritative prepared substrate.
- field-resolution rule and policy version; and

Adding or replacing a provider is lawful only by adding or changing its source adapter and the affected field-resolution rules. It must not require unrelated downstream modules to learn a provider-specific order.
- canonical-field resolution-receipt references where more than one source candidate was admitted; and

1. `PreparedDataEnvelope` — one immutable, versioned K05 prepared-data authority envelope carrying common identity, source/capture lineage, temporal facts, policy/schema/derivation versions, fingerprints, validation/completeness state and exactly one tagged typed payload variant;

3. `PreparedDataBuilder` — the side-effect-free M03 service that validates admitted M01/M02 inputs, executes explicit field-resolution and derivation law, and emits a `PreparedDataEnvelope` or an explicit non-emission failure.

Every contributing input to an authoritative prepared envelope must be an admitted immutable M01 source artefact/raw-signal contract or an admitted immutable M02 calendar projection. For each contribution M03 must preserve or reference:

A versioned field-resolution policy must name the semantic field, mandatory/optional state, admitted source roles, type/unit/temporal comparison law, equality tolerance where applicable, authorised owning source role, bounded fallback roles where lawful, and the exact unresolved/degraded consequence. A generic resolver may execute this policy but may not derive precedence from caller order, mapping order, non-null status, recency, confidence or source naming unless the policy expressly owns that rule.
- all material field-resolution and derivation receipt references;
- exact input semantic fields and their field-resolution receipt identities or sole-source candidate identities;

- Semantic owner: parallel risk authority owns bounded row `5.8` envelope evaluation and output meaning. Current alpha implementation evidence is allocated to `src/nvda_desk/risk/parallel/evaluate.py`; `src/nvda_desk/services/parallel_risk_lane_service.py` coordinates calls and does not acquire separate policy or persistence authority.

- `Calendar Projection` / `CalendarProjection` / `calendar_projection` [`add_new`] = one deterministic, side-effect-free M02 projection that coalesces, selects, degrades or withholds calendar facts under explicit field-resolution and temporal law while preserving complete candidate/source lineage.

- `Field Resolution Receipt` / `FieldResolutionReceipt` / `field_resolution_receipt` [`add_new`] = one immutable M03 K06 record of all admitted field candidates and the deterministic selected, coalesced, unavailable, degraded or withheld outcome under one explicit versioned field-resolution policy; and

- `Prepared Data Builder` / `PreparedDataBuilder` / `prepared_data_builder` [`add_new`] = the deterministic, side-effect-free M03 service that validates admitted M01/M02 inputs, executes explicit field-resolution and derivation law, and emits one Prepared Data Envelope or explicit non-emission failure.
